Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1793 (human single-protein target). Join activities to assays for assay_chembl_id, to target_dictionary for target_type and tax_id, to molecule_dictionary for molecule_chembl_id, and to compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
